task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the Appearance > Editor section in the WordPress admin panel.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the WordPress sidebar with 'Appearance' selected and the 'Editor' (Site Editor) interface loading.

task_completion.description: The 404 template heading is updated to the specific required text.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Site Editor canvas showing the 404 template with the text 'Oops! We couldn't find that page.' visible in a heading block.

task_completion.description: A Search block and a Latest Posts block are added to the 404 template.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Site Editor canvas or the Block Layers/List View showing both a 'Search' block and a 'Latest Posts' block inserted into the 404 template.

task_completion.description: The Footer template part is modified to include the specific copyright paragraph.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Site Editor showing the Footer template part being edited with a paragraph block containing '© 2026 My WordPress Blog. All rights reserved.'

task_completion.description: The changes are saved specifically as template/template part overrides in the Site Editor.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save' sidebar or multi-entity saving panel appearing that lists '404' (Template) and 'Footer' (Template Part) with checkboxes, followed by a 'Site updated' snackbar notification.

integrity.description: The agent used the WordPress graphical interface rather than WP-CLI or direct database manipulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the WordPress block editor and sidebar menus; no terminal windows are used for the primary task.

integrity.description: The agent did not leave default 'Type / to choose a block' placeholders in the modified areas.
integrity.visual_evidence: The final screenshots of the 404 and Footer templates show the specific requested content instead of empty block placeholders.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the Site Editor (FSE) specifically, not the standard Page/Post editor.
integrity.visual_evidence: The UI shows the dark-themed Site Editor sidebar (Templates/Patterns) rather than the standard white-themed Page editor.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The 404 template must contain the exact string 'Oops! We couldn't find that page.' and include the blocks 'wp:search' and 'wp:latest-posts'. The Footer template part must contain the exact string '© 2026 My WordPress Blog. All rights reserved.' All changes must be saved within the Site Editor interface.
